# EIRVAN

> EIRVAN (EIRVAN.COM) is a high-performance multi-niche publication and research platform exploring breakthroughs in artificial intelligence, deep technology, global quantitative finance, cognitive productivity, and cellular longevity.

## Editorial Focus & Canonical Channels

- [Technology & Artificial Intelligence](https://eirvan.com/category/technology-ai): Research briefings and technical analyses on neuromorphic silicon, photonic supercomputing, quantum annealing, and edge inference.
- [Global Markets & Quantitative Finance](https://eirvan.com/category/global-markets-finance): Quantitative strategies, dark pools, algorithmic arbitrage, sovereign wealth allocation, and macroeconomic risk modeling.
- [Productivity & Mindset](https://eirvan.com/category/productivity-mindset): Cognitive ergonomics, 90-minute ultradian sprints, deep work systems, and neurobiological baseline calibration.
- [Biotech & Cellular Longevity](https://eirvan.com/category/biotech-longevity): Human NAD+ vascular clinical trials, CRISPR epigenetic methylation, telomerase maintenance, and cellular rejuvenation protocols.

## Pro Publications & Research Products

- [EIRVAN Pro Research Store](https://eirvan.com/products): Institutional monographs, FPGA trading codebases, and membership passes.
- [EIRVAN Pro Annual Intelligence Pass](https://eirvan.com/product/annual-pro-research-pass): All-access annual research subscription.
- [2026 Neuromorphic Silicon Dossier](https://eirvan.com/product/neuromorphic-silicon-dossier): 140-page monograph on analog spiking compute.
- [Dark Pool FPGA Arbitrage Suite](https://eirvan.com/product/dark-pool-fpga-arbitrage-suite): Microsecond trading simulator and codebase.
- [Ultradian Ergonomics Blueprint](https://eirvan.com/product/ultradian-ergonomics-blueprint): Circadian productivity protocol manual.
- [Cellular Longevity Meta-Analysis](https://eirvan.com/product/cellular-longevity-meta-analysis): Human clinical trials synthesis on NAD+ precursors.
